name: $dbBackup
description: SQLite: writes a consistent copy of the database into the backups folder next to it while the bot runs, and returns its path. Never overwrites a file. Other databases: an error that names client.db.export()

args.name: file name
args.description: Name of the copy in the backups folder (a plain file name; .db is added). Defaults to reforge-<date>.db

name: $dbPing
description: Returns the database round trip in ms (works on every database type, MongoDB included)

args.name: full
args.description: Return every decimal instead of 2

name: $deleteRecords
description: Deletes the variables matching your inputs. At least one input is required (use $wipeDB to delete everything). Name and value accept % (any text) and _ (one character)

args.name: name
args.description: The variable name; % matches any text, _ one character.

args.name: id
args.description: The ID of the user, guild, channel, or any other type.

args.name: type
args.description: The type of the variable.

args.name: value
args.description: The value; % matches any text, _ one character.

args.name: guild ID
args.description: The guild to which the member, channel, or role belongs (also a guild the bot left).

name: $getDB
description: Returns every stored variable as JSON

name: $searchDB
description: Returns the variables matching your inputs as JSON. Name and value accept % (any text) and _ (one character)

args.name: name
args.description: The variable name; % matches any text, _ one character.

args.name: id
args.description: The ID of the user, guild, channel, or any other type.

args.name: type
args.description: The type of the variable.

args.name: value
args.description: The value; % matches any text, _ one character.

args.name: guild ID
args.description: The guild to which the member, channel, or role belongs.

name: $wipeDB
description: Deletes every variable and every cooldown in the database

name: $channelLeaderboard
description: Creates a leaderboard specific to channels based on a variable.

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the variable used to create the leaderboard.

args.name: guild ID
args.description: The guild ID of the channels, defaults to the guild of the command.

args.name: sort type
args.description: The sorting order for the leaderboard, either ascending (asc) or descending (desc, the default).

args.name: max
args.description: The maximum number of entries per page, defaults to 10.

args.name: page
args.description: The page number, defaults to 1.

args.name: separator
args.description: The separator between rows, defaults to a new line.

args.name: envValue
args.description: The variable name for $env: $env[<name>;id], $env[<name>;value] and $env[<name>;channel_name].

args.name: envPosition
args.description: The variable name for $env to get the position with $env[<name>].

args.name: code
args.description: Code executed for each row. Remember to use $return, otherwise it will not return anything.

args.name: name
